description: Implementation of the 'Add' feature for favorites, including command validator and request handler to add an article to user's favorites in an ASP.NET Core application.

classes.name: Add.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Slug field in the command is not null or empty.

classes.name: Add.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the process of adding an article to the current user's favorites, involving database lookups and conditional creation.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Manages the request to add an article to favorites, performing validation, database operations, and returning the article envelope.
